statement: The real nine-point synthesis instance called Problem 3 has 384 real labelled-mechanism solutions identified by 256-bit soft certification, yielding 64 real mechanism/coupler-curve classes under the paper’s sixfold symmetry.

answer.text: Problem 3 supplies 384 real polynomial solutions, or 64 classes after sixfold symmetry, with floating-point soft certification.

source.location: Section 5.2, Table 1 and following paragraph for Problem 3 (printed p.14; PDF index 13)

notes:
A lower bound on attainable real classes, not a maximum. The paper uses floating-point soft certification; physical order/branch admissibility is more restrictive.

Imported from the 2026-10-26 catalogue record R_787f0524ce8d41f6; the source claim has not been newly rechecked against the paper for this beta import.

The computation first obtains 8,652 approximate polynomial roots. The sixfold quotient uses side exchange and Roberts cognates. This gives a lower-bound example rather than a proof that 64 is maximal.
scope: Specific real nine-point data from Problem 3 of Wampler–Morgan–Sommese (1992).
